attempts.summary: Configured VLAN access-port segmentation on node1: eth1 (link to node2) is an untagged access port in VLAN 10, eth2 (link to node3) is an untagged access port in VLAN 20, on a VLAN-aware Linux bridge (br0) since SONiC-VS's config-CLI Ethernet* abstraction is unbound from the real virtio NICs. node1 has L3 presence in each VLAN via br0.10 (192.168.201.1/24) and br0.20 (192.168.202.1/24). node2 (192.168.201.2) and node3 (192.168.202.3) each keep a working link to node1 in their own VLAN, and are provably isolated from each other at L2 (verified even when placed in the same subnet). Config was made persistent via a systemd unit on node1 and systemd-networkd config on node2/node3. All three nodes were restarted one at a time with boot_id changes confirmed and full VLAN/connectivity/isolation state re-verified after each restart.
